description: This source file defines REST API endpoints for managing organizations within a software system. It includes functions for creating, updating, deleting, listing, and fetching details about organizations, as well as managing organization members. The file utilizes FastAPI, interacts with a database via Prisma, and handles complex logic such as permission checks, nested data transformations, and budget management for organizations.
